titulo: Live: France's Yellow Vest movement calls for new round of protests after weekend unrest
cuerpo: France's Yellow Vest movement called for a new round of protests on Saturday, dubbed Act II, as the country reeled from two days of unrest that saw town halls burned down and hundreds of businesses looted or damaged. Interior Minister Laurent Nunez earlier admitted that police had "lost control" of the protests in several cities after President Emmanuel Macron rejected his offer to resign. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
